title: Personalized Basketball Below Hoop Comforter with Name and Number Design 1
description:
Bring the excitement of the court straight to your bedroom with the custom Sports Comforter from Jeminise. This personalized bedding set features a vibrant basketball design, making it the perfect custom gift for sports enthusiasts, players, and kids. Fully customizable with a name and number, it adds a unique, personal touch to any sports-themed bedroom decor.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize with your own Name and Number for a truly unique and personal sports bedding set.
  • High-Quality Material: Made from 100% Brushed Polyester Fabric that is soft, comfy, durable, and lightweight.
  • Superior Construction: Features a whole-piece microfiber filling with tight, smooth, and compact stitching along the edges to prevent clumping or shifting.
  • All-Season Comfort: Lightweight yet cozy design provides comfortable warmth suitable for all seasons.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; dries quickly on a low or air-dry setting to restore its fluffiness.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Cotton/ Polyester
Color Basketball D01
Pattern Basketball Print
Style Vintage
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Customization Name and Number (2 text inputs)
